title: PriceCharting Scraper: Game and Collectible Prices
description: Get loose, complete in box, new and graded prices for video games, consoles and trading cards from the PriceCharting price guide, by console or search term. Optional product page details with release date, UPC and recent sales.
readme:
# PriceCharting Scraper

Get prices for video games, consoles and collectibles from the [PriceCharting](https://www.pricecharting.com/) price guide. Give the actor one or more console names, or search words, and it returns one record per item: name, link, console, loose price, complete in box (CIB) price, new price, graded price when shown, and the image. Switch on `includeDetails` to also open each product page and add release date, genre, publisher, UPC, every price point, other editions and recent sales. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One record per item from a console list, 150 items per page.
- Several consoles and search words in one run. Set `maxItems` and the actor reads pages until it has that many items.
- Each item once per run, even if it shows up in more than one list.
- Prices as numbers in US dollars.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Items already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for items that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/pricecharting-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `pricecharting-scraper` to get the 50 most popular Nintendo 64 games with their loose, complete and new prices as a CSV."

## Data extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `id` | `3977` |
| `url` | `"https://www.pricecharting.com/game/nintendo-64/zelda-ocarina-of-time"` |
| `name` | `"Zelda Ocarina of Time"` |
| `consoleName`, `consoleSlug` | `"Nintendo 64"`, `"nintendo-64"` |
| `currency` | `"USD"` |
| `loosePrice` | `46.79` |
| `cibPrice` | `186.56` |
| `newPrice` | `683.88` |
| `gradedPrice` | `9500` when the site shows a graded price, else empty |
| `looseLabel`, `cibLabel`, `newLabel` | The column names the site uses on that page, such as `"Loose Price"`, `"CIB Price"`, `"New Price"` |
| `imageUrl` | Item image |
| `source`, `sourceQuery`, `position` | Where the row came from (`console` or `search`), the console or search word, and its place in that list |
| `scrapedAt` | `"2026-11-07T14:12:03Z"` |

With `includeDetails` on, each record also has:

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `category` | `"video-games"` |
| `boxOnlyPrice`, `manualOnlyPrice` | `65`, `19.49` |
| `allPrices` | `{"Loose": 46.79, "Item & Box": 111.79, "Complete": 186.56, "New": 683.88}` |
| `genre`, `releaseDate`, `publisher`, `developer` | `"Action & Adventure"`, `"November 23, 1998"`, `"Nintendo"`, `"Nintendo"` |
| `esrbRating`, `modelNumber`, `playerCount` | `"Everyone"`, `"#NUS-CZLE-USA"`, `"1 player"` |
| `upc`, `asin`, `epid` | `"045496870041"`, `"B00000DMB3"`, `"214719169"` |
| `description` | Description text |
| `variants` | Other editions with name, id and link |
| `attributes` | Every attribute row of the page, keyed by its label |
| `recentSales` | Up to 5 completed sales for each of loose, cib, new and graded, with date, title, price and listing id |

Fields that a page does not show are returned empty. On trading card sets the three price columns are ungraded, grade 9 and PSA 10 prices; `looseLabel`, `cibLabel` and `newLabel` tell you which.

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for items that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Product scraped (`product-result`) | $0.0025 per product ($2.50 per 1,000) |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved item. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit. Turning on `includeDetails` does not change the price per item, but the run takes longer because it opens one extra page per item.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `consoles` | string[] | Console or set names as in the address, such as `nintendo-64`, or full addresses such as `https://www.pricecharting.com/console/nintendo-64`. | none |
| `searchTerms` | string[] | Words to search for, such as `zelda`. A search gives up to 100 items. | none |
| `maxItems` | integer | Most items to return across all inputs. 0 uses 200. | `200` |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | Open each product page for the extra fields above. | `false` |

At least one of `consoles` or `searchTerms` is required.

## Usage examples

### The first 200 Nintendo 64 items

```json
{
  "consoles": ["nintendo-64"],
  "maxItems": 200
}
```

### Two consoles

```json
{
  "consoles": ["sega-saturn", "https://www.pricecharting.com/console/atari-lynx"],
  "maxItems": 500
}
```

### Search with product page details

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["zelda"],
  "maxItems": 20,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

## Output sample

```json
{
  "id": 3977,
  "url": "https://www.pricecharting.com/game/nintendo-64/zelda-ocarina-of-time",
  "name": "Zelda Ocarina of Time",
  "consoleName": "Nintendo 64",
  "consoleSlug": "nintendo-64",
  "currency": "USD",
  "loosePrice": 46.79,
  "cibPrice": 186.56,
  "newPrice": 683.88,
  "gradedPrice": null,
  "looseLabel": "Loose Price",
  "cibLabel": "CIB Price",
  "newLabel": "New Price",
  "imageUrl": "https://storage.googleapis.com/images.pricecharting.com/bidbex33joqxpepk/60.jpg",
  "source": "console",
  "sourceQuery": "nintendo-64",
  "position": 1,
  "scrapedAt": "2026-11-07T14:12:03Z"
}
```

Results are saved to the default dataset. Export them as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read them through the API.

## Limitations

- Prices are in US dollars and are the current guide prices at the time of the run. The actor does not return a price history.
- A search returns at most 100 items. Use a console name to read a full list.
- A console list can only be read in the order the site gives by default, or in the order of the `sort` value of the address you paste.
- A graded price appears on the list only for sets that have one. Use `includeDetails` to get it from the product page.
- Some items have no price for a condition. Those fields are empty, not zero.
- Recent sales are the few newest per condition that the product page shows. They are not the full sales history.
- If a console name does not exist, the run reports that no products were found.

## FAQ

**Which console names can I use?**
Use the name from the address of the console page, for example `nintendo-64`, `gameboy-advance`, `playstation-2` or `pokemon-base-set`.

**How many items can I get from one console?**
All of them. Each page holds 150 items and the actor reads pages until it has `maxItems` items or the list ends.

**What does a run cost?**
The start price plus the item price for every saved item. Check the pricing table above for the current numbers.

**What status does a run end with?**
The run status says how many items were delivered. If the site refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged. If a console or search has no items, the run ends normally and says so.

**Can I get the price history chart?**
No. This actor returns current prices and a few recent sales, not the monthly chart data.
